title: Double Yangian and reflection algebras of the Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{M|N}$, II: Quantum currents
summary: In this paper, we continue our research on the double Yangian and reflection algebras of the Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{M|N}$. Extending the Etingof-Kazhdan construction, we introduce the structure of $h$-adic quantum vertex superalgebra on the vacuum module $V^c(\mathfrak{gl}_{M|N})$ over the double Yangian of level $c\in\mathbb{C}$. Next, we construct families of central elements in the completed double Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_{M|N}$ at the critical level.
